% The conversion WITHOUT the workaround: what convert_deck.py alone leaves
% behind. Its title regex ([^{}]*) does not match a nested-brace title, so all
% three headers keep their braced title, which ltx-talk renders as body text.
% [c] and \sc are converted because those are convert_deck.py's job and it does
% them; only the title fold is missing.
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en, pdfversion=2.0, pdfstandard={a-4,ua-2}, tagging=on}
\documentclass{ltx-talk}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}[vertical-alignment=center]{\only<1>{Example}\only<2>{Find a plan for}}
Single braced title, nested.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}[vertical-alignment=center]{Arc consistency}{{\scshape Inference}}
Double braced title, nested.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}<2>{Overlay {Planning} Title}
Overlay frame, nested title.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
